text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a car. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to detect pedestrians, other vehicles, and road signs. It also helps doctors analyse medical images and allows phones to unlock using facial recognition. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more common.
